name: walk_carry_box
text: A person walks steadily forward holding a heavy cardboard box against the belly with both bent arms. The forearms are horizontal, the palms face upward supporting the lower corners at waist height, the head tilts slightly to see around the box.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双手在腰前托箱，小步平衡前进并略歪头；自由试片手位偏低，增加双手抬高20厘米的末端约束后再提取完整步态生成循环。手距约61厘米。
